description: This file contains automated tests (unit tests) for the DataGroupService class in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing data permission retrieval and collection functions within the Authorization service.

classes.name: DataGroupServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DataGroupService, verifying data permission retrieval and collection functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the DataGroupService instance before each test.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermission
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a single DataGroupPermission for a given role and data group.

methods.name: testGetDataGroups
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all data groups, expecting an empty list as per mock.

methods.name: testGetDataGroup
methods.description: Tests fetching a specific DataGroup by identifier.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithOnlyOnePermissionForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests the collection of permissions for a data group with a single permission set.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithTwoPermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests the collection aggregation logic for two permissions associated with a single data group.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionWithMultiplePermissionsForDataGroup
methods.description: Tests the aggregation when multiple permission entries (including different access levels and different data groups) are present.
